case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost environment so clearly. We have looked at it carefully, and our own records show a somewhat different picture:

Our orders of None with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

On that basis we cannot accept the proposed price. We value working with Donautal and would like to put things on a stable footing for both sides:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.54; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.38; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.50; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Each option offers the security of a longer contract term. If your pricing committee needs anything further to review them, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified your purchase history and appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract. We cannot offer a fixed price for 24 months, but we can agree to this longer term by including an AS-14404 index clause. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

We therefore propose a base price of EUR 5.48 for a 24-month contract with 30 days payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause. As an alternative, we present a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our presentangebot is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our price history so carefully. We appreciate that you took it into account.

We welcome your proposal of an index clause on the alloy surcharge. It gives both sides a fair mechanism over a longer term, and we have built each option around it, as you asked:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.40; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.24; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.36; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

All three options include the clause and the longer contract term you were open to. They differ only in the balance between unit price and payment terms, so you can choose the combination that suits you best. If your pricing committee needs a summary or further details for its approval, we will gladly provide them.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We are pleased that we agree on the 24-month contract and the AS-14404 index clause. As a dedicated distributor, we always strive to support your supply needs with our extensive range and reliable service. We therefore maintain our offer of EUR 5.40 for 60 days payment terms and a 24-month contract with the index clause as originally proposed.

For your reference, our current offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Regarding indexation, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Please note that this proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your reply and for confirming that we agree on the longer contract term and the index clause on the alloy surcharge. That gives both sides a solid, transparent basis.

We have set out three options, all built on that same index clause. Option A matches your current offer. Options B and C give you faster payment in return for a lower base price, if cash flow is of value to you:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.40; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.24; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.36; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

The options are structured to be easy to take to your pricing committee. If your approval needs further detail on the index mechanism, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your confirmation that your Option A aligns with our pricing for a 60-day payment term. 

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your needs with our extensive range and dedicated service. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

We therefore maintain our offer of EUR 5.40 per unit for a 24-month contract with 60 days payment and our standard AS-14404 index clause. For full clarity, our proposal stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that our proposed index clause does not include a deadband, ensuring immediate and fair adjustments for both sides. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
